sentences.en: The airplane used a rocket motor to assist with takeoff.
sentences.zh: 这架飞机使用了火箭发动机来辅助起飞。

sentences.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能帮我打理花园。

sentences.en: They can't assist you if you don't have your receipt.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有收据，他们无法帮你。

senses.zh: 援助，帮助，协助的器械，搀扶
